subsections.title: CUNY Tech Prep
subsections.subtitle: Fellow, Web Development
items: Selected for a competitive web development fellowship with students from across the 11 CUNY senior colleges, where Fellows create technical projects using tools such as React, Node + Express, and PostgreSQL.
Learned industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment, such as MVC, version control with Git/GitHub, agile & Scrum with Trello and Slack, test-driven development, and CI/CD.

subsections.title: Jupiter Leo Productions
subsections.subtitle: Software Development Intern
items: Collaborated with a team of 3 to develop interactive educational games using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, resulting in a 34% improvement in course engagement and learning outcomes.
Updated a financial education platform by adding multimedia content, such as images and interactive elements, to enhance visual engagement and user experience for 100+ users.
Streamlined content creation workflows by integrating generative AI tools, reducing manual design efforts by 50%, and accelerating production time by 20%.
Improved skills in responsive design, accessibility, and collaborative development through designer & educator feedback.

subsections.title: Flocksync
subsections.subtitle: Flutter, Firebase, Firestore, Dart, Node.js, OpenStreetMap
items: Built a cross-platform rental management application in Flutter to help tenants and property managers centralize communication, maintenance, and property-related workflows.
Implemented Firebase Authentication and Firestore data models for secure account creation, tenant onboarding, role-based access control, and real-time app updates.
Integrated OpenStreetMap APIs for address autocomplete and verification through a Node.js backend, significantly improving property lookup and input accuracy.

subsections.title: HerRide
subsections.subtitle: Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, Clerk, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
items: Developed a full-stack, women-only ridesharing platform using Next.js in a team of 4 as part of CUNY Tech Prep.
Integrated secure user authentication and management using Clerk and designed PostgreSQL schemas with role-based access using Supabase.
Contributed to product design and planning by prototyping in Figma and coordinating features, requirements, and tech stack decisions using Trello and Notion.

subsections.title: Check My Fit, CTP Hacks 2025
subsections.subtitle: Node.js, Express, EJS, HTML, CSS
items: Participated in CTP Hacks 2025 with a team of 4, building a full-stack MVP in under 48 hours, while competing among 20+ teams.
Implemented a web application, creating an outfit tracker to help people manage their personal wardrobe.
Built the user interface using Express and EJS templating, integrating it with a MySQL database to support dynamic outfit tracking and scheduling.

subsections.title: PVD Image Steganography
subsections.subtitle: C++, OpenCV
items: Created an image steganography program in C++ that encodes and decodes text within an image by manipulating differences in pixel RGB values, while keeping image quality intact.
Used the OpenCV library for image processing and support for various image formats.
Implemented custom classes and data structures, including queues, to improve programming encapsulation and efficiency.

unused-projects.title: EzRecycle
unused-projects.subtitle: React, Node.js, TailwindCSS, HTML, CSS
items: Created a web-based recycling guide with a team of 4, simplifying everyday recycling and disposal habits using React.
Designed interactive components such as resource sections and an interactive quiz, leveraging the Gemini AI API to provide personalized recycling suggestions.

unused-projects.title: Hawk's Highway, HunterHacks
unused-projects.subtitle: React, Node.js, Supabase, HTML, CSS
items: Participated in HunterHacks Spring '25 with a team of 4, building a full-stack MVP in under 48 hours, while competing among 40+ teams.
Developed a web-based travel planner that gamifies carbon footprint reduction for commuters using React and Supabase.
Built a leaderboard and points system to reward and encourage community-driven eco-friendly habits.

unused-projects.title: PySweeper
unused-projects.subtitle: Python, Pygame, PyInstaller, Github Actions
items: Developed a Minesweeper game in Python using the Pygame library, by creating an user interface and handling input events.
Utilized PyInstaller and Github Actions to automate building executables for Windows, Linux, and macOS systems.
